configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce3e5ae-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT art.client_id AS patient_id, p.birthdate, p.gender, art.tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art INNER JOIN person p ON art.client_id = p.person_id WHERE art.tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND art.tuberculosis_treatment_start_date IS NOT NULL", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}, {"key": "gender", "expr": "gender", "type": "coded", "label": "Gender"}, {"key": "tb_treatment_stop_date", "expr": "tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date", "type": "date", "label": "TB Treatment Stop Date"}], "conditions": [{"key": "tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date", "label": "TB Treatment Stop Date", "column": "tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date", "handler": "DATE_RANGE", "operator": "BETWEEN", "valueType": "date"}, {"key": "tuberculosis_treatment_start_date", "label": "TB Treatment Started", "column": "tuberculosis_treatment_start_date", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "IS_NOT_NULL", "valueType": "boolean"}], "dateColumn": "tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT art.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
WHERE art.tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date >= :startDate 
  AND art.tuberculosis_treatment_stop_date < :endDate
  AND art.tuberculosis_treatment_start_date IS NOT NULL
